summary: Two men on a daylong trek surveying mining claims near the headwaters of Junction Creek failed to return Friday; La Plata County SAR began searching at daybreak Saturday along Junction Creek Road — one man walked back to the vehicle Saturday while the second was located by a K-9 unit just after noon Sunday about 2 1/4 miles down Elk Creek canyon, unharmed but cold, tired and hungry after a rain-soaked night out; Flight for Life helicopter assisted Saturday in heavy rain, hail and fog
location: Junction Creek headwaters / Elk Creek (14 mi up Junction Creek Road)
responding_agency: La Plata County Search and Rescue (18 searchers, 2 K-9 units; Flight for Life helo assist)
notes: SNIPPET-SOURCED via search-index full-text capture (crawled ~69 days before 2026-09-12); the archives page serves a ColdFusion server error on direct open (re-checked this run) — verify against the live page on the next Telegraph rotation. Date recorded at search-conclusion date per convention (search began Saturday 2013-09-14; second subject located Sunday 2013-09-15 just after noon; the pair failed to return Friday 2013-09-13). Subjects unnamed in the story; property owner Harold Luzar (Neglected Mine) gave searchers shelter at his cabin.
